Container.Name: game-sauce
Container.Overview: A self-hosted game library for your household: your ROMs, your digital games (PlayStation, Nintendo, Xbox, Steam) and the boxed games on your shelf, with covers and details found for you, play in the browser, and a small private chat between the people in your home. Each person has their own library, favourites and accounts. Your ROM folders are only read, never changed. The first time it starts, sign in with the account shown in the container's log (or the password you set below) and change it under Settings.

Config.Name: Web UI port
Config.Description: The port you open in your browser: http://your-server:8765

Config.Name: Database and settings
Config.Description: The library database, accounts and the key that protects stored logins. Keep this private and back it up.

Config.Name: Covers and imported ROMs
Config.Description: Downloaded covers and artwork, plus any ROMs you upload through the page.

Config.Name: ROM folder (read-only)
Config.Description: Where your ROMs already are. In game-sauce add /roms (or a folder inside it) as a source. It is mounted read-only, so nothing here can be changed.

Config.Name: Admin username
Config.Description: The first account, made the first time it starts (ignored once any account exists).

Config.Name: Admin password
Config.Description: At least 10 characters with a letter and a number. Leave blank and a password is made for you and shown once in the container's log (click the container, then Logs).

Config.Name: Secret key (optional)
Config.Description: Optional: your own key for protecting stored logins. Leave blank to have one made and kept in the data folder.

Config.Name: IGDB client ID (optional)
Config.Description: Optional extra source of game details, free from a Twitch developer app.

Config.Name: IGDB client secret (optional)
Config.Description: Goes with the IGDB client ID.
